## Standing operator rules
- “separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout' in between your other work.”
- “Run these steps in order, one at a time.”
- “Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.”
- “Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.”
- “Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint.”
- “Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.”
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”

## Current objective
Fix intermittent invoice-sync `409 Conflict` caused by concurrent submissions; refund double-counting work is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Shared billing helper without `dest="currency"`: broke `ParsedArgs.currency`.
- Command-local currency declaration: duplicated `--currency/-c`.
- Adding `invoices(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest write latency.

## Recent work
Full tests pass: 318 passed, 4 skipped. Integration reproduction failed 1/20, confirming a race in `InvoiceSyncService.submit`, which forwards idempotency keys but does not persist completed responses.
